entity_types.name: GovernmentAgency
entity_types.description: Regulatory or public safety bodies involved in anti-scam and tech regulation.

attributes.name: authority_level
attributes.description: The scope of the agency's regulatory power.

entity_types.name: CreativeProfessional
entity_types.description: Individuals in creative industries such as directors, artists, and designers.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the creative professional.

attributes.name: creative_domain

entity_types.name: TechInfluencer

attributes.name: handle_id

attributes.name: tech_focus

entity_types.name: SeniorCitizen

attributes.name: full_name

attributes.name: vulnerability_score

entity_types.name: MediaOutlet
entity_types.description: News organizations and digital publishers that report on corporate events.

attributes.name: outlet_name

attributes.name: audience_type

entity_types.name: Executive
entity_types.description: High-level corporate leaders who represent the bank's strategic decisions.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the executive.

attributes.name: job_title

entity_types.name: Customer

attributes.name: full_name

attributes.name: loyalty_tier

entity_types.name: Person

attributes.name: full_name

attributes.name: biography

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: A general organization or group not covered by specific types.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization.

attributes.name: entity_type_desc
